checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No other fee described as mandatory or non-declinable appears besides the basic services fee.
The embalming disclosure and the $795 embalming price are both on page 1.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
The alternative-container disclosure and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range are both on page 2.
Direct cremation is offered with options using a purchaser-provided container, fiberboard, or wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists transportation to crematory and cremation as included, and no separate crematory cash advance is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have itemized prices, and other mentioned items have their own lines.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not treated as packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase, apart from required disclosure wording.
No text claims long-term preservation or protection from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no required disclosure appears obscured.
